skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The lady's favorite lavallière.
The sapphire atop the red silk is as if it were fashioned from one of her eyes. The lady needs only sit upright in satisfaction for the operators to decide to draw a new portrait of her.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The lady continues her search of this great land in high spirits, amusing herself along the way.
With her twin tails, she flits through endless time. What would the next interesting game be? But disturbing the operators as they work would not... (The rest is covered by a pawprint.)
